description: This file defines the EntityCrypto utility class in the Apache OFBiz project. It provides methods for encryption and decryption of data, key management, and supports multiple storage handlers for cryptographic operations, including legacy support. The class interacts with entity key storage and uses cryptographic algorithms such as AES and DES.

classes.name: EntityCrypto
classes.description: Final utility class providing cryptographic functionalities for entity data encryption, decryption, and key management within OFBiz. Supports multiple storage handlers and handles legacy encryption methods.

methods.name: EntityCrypto
methods.description: Constructor initializing the crypto utility with a delegator and optional KEK (Key Encryption Key).

methods.name: clearKeyCache
methods.description: Clears the in-memory cache of cryptographic keys.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts an object into a hex-encoded string using specified key and method.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a hex-encoded string back into the original object, handling backward compatibility.

methods.name: doDecrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption with a specific storage handler.

methods.name: findKey
methods.description: Looks up a cryptographic key by name, fetching from storage if necessary.

methods.name: createKey
methods.description: Generates a new cryptographic key and stores it securely.
